(1) SIG/foundation opcodes: every constant in no/nordicsemi/android/mesh/opcodes/{ApplicationMessageOpCodes,ConfigMessageOpCodes}.java (the duplicate alias trGENERIC_DELTA_SET is folded into GENERIC_DELTA_SET) -> one item each, id msg:op:<opcode hex, 2 digits if <0x80 else 4 digits>. (2) Message classes: every file in no/nordicsemi/android/mesh/transport/ matching ^(Config|Generic|Health|Light|Scene|Scheduler|Sensor|Time)[A-Za-z]*\.java whose class 'extends ConfigMessage|ConfigStatusMessage|ApplicationMessage|ApplicationStatusMessage|SensorMessage'; opcode = literal returned by getOpCode(); layout read from assembleMessageParameters()/parseStatusParameters(); key = DevKey for ConfigMessage/ConfigStatusMessage (ConfigMessageState uses node.getDeviceKey(), AKF 0), AppKey otherwise (AKF 1, AID = K4). GenericPropertyGet/GenericPropertyStatus take the opcode at runtime: the Get opcodes are the int literals passed to 'new GenericPropertyGet(' anywhere in the tree (33323/33325/33327 -> msg:op:822b/822d/822f), the Status opcodes are the 0x46/0x4A/0x4E constants. (3) Parse direction: every 'getOpCode() == N' / '!= N' in transport/DefaultNoOperationMessageState.java (plus the ProxyConfigFilterStatus control branch). (4) Vendor (CID 0x0527=1319): all subclasses of VendorModelMessageAcked/VendorModelMessageUnacked outside the Nordic package (grep -rn 'extends VendorModelMessage' -> G7/a..h, H7/a,b) plus every direct 'new f(' call in JungMeshApiImpl; send ints = every integer literal in 337664..337919 (0x052700..0x0527FF) anywhere in sources; receive ints = every literal equal to ((0xC0+k)<<16)|0x2705, k=0..63 (python regex scan of all .java). Wire id = the 3 opcode bytes, msg:op:<b0><27><05>. (5) Vendor sub-commands: JH Scheduler header nibble values from p056e8/h.java (super(0/1/2/15)) crossed with the builders B7/c,d,e,f (Get/Set) and resolvers AbstractC1934m0 subclasses (C1940o0, C1928k0, C1931l0, C1937n0); Scene Action Setup list-vs-single split from A7/b, A7/g and AbstractC1970y1 subclasses (C1, C1967x1) -> msg:sub:<wire opcode>-<subcommand hex | 0 | n>. (6) Proxy configuration messages: constants in opcodes/ProxyConfigMessageOpCodes.java -> msg:proxy:<2-digit hex>. (7) msg:mech:<lowercased class/method name> for the four shared codec/dispatch mechanisms (createVendorOpCode, DefaultNoOperationMessageState, waitForStatusMessage, k0 bit packer). JUNG-layer usage for each SIG item = grep -rnE 'new <Class>\(' over de A7 B7 C7 D7 E7 G7 H7 P7 p234v7 p245w7 p254x7 p277z7 (senders) and grep -rlw <Class> de/jung/junghome/data/mesh/resolver (parsers); expected-status opcodes = the int assigned to the field returned by d() in every p234v7/A7/B7/C7/D7/p245w7/p254x7/p277z7 MessageBuilder. Second sweep (different angle): (a) listed every p234v7/*,A7-D7,p245w7,p254x7,p277z7 '*MessageBuilder.kt' class and the 'new X(' it builds; (b) grep 'OpCodes\.' constant uses in JUNG code (numbers 85-100 inlined by jadx as SENSOR_*/LIGHT_LC_*/SCENE_STATUS constants are false positives, not message uses); (c) grep of 'new (Config|Generic|Light|Scene|Scheduler|Sensor|Time|Proxy|Health)' in no/nordicsemi/android/mesh outside transport/ (none: MeshManagerApi builds no messages itself); (d) cross-check against docs/android/vendor-models.md opcode table and docs/parity/captures-inventory.json opcodes. Transport control PDUs (Segment Ack, Heartbeat) are out of this domain. Items sorted by id; line numbers are computed by the generator from the regexes above, so a rerun reproduces the same ids. Third sweep (adversarial ledger pass, different angle; found nothing new): (e) every 'public int getOpCode() { return <literal>; }' in ALL 234 files of no/nordicsemi/android/mesh/transport (no filename filter) plus every constant in all four opcodes/*.java (incl. TransportLayerOpCodes) mapped to an id and diffed against items -> 0 missing; (f) integer-literal scan of every .java outside androidx/android/com.google/kotlin/org/io/okhttp/retrofit/j$ for 0x8000..0x804F, 0x8200..0x82FF, (0xC0..0xFF)<<16|0x2705 and 0x052700..0x0527FF -> 0 ids missing; (g) every 'extends (ApplicationMessage|ConfigMessage|MeshMessage|ApplicationStatusMessage|ConfigStatusMessage|SensorMessage|ProxyConfigMessage|VendorModelMessage*)' outside the Nordic transport package -> only G7/a..h and H7/a,b; (h) every 'new <transport class>(' outside the builder packages -> only JungMeshApiImpl, data/mesh/api/a.java (ConfigNodeReset), data/mesh/c.java (ConfigModelAppBind), all already items; (i) every class 'extends W<' (MessageBuilder) in any package -> the listed packages plus p266y7/a,b (AstroSchedulerRegister-style LBC Admin Property Get/Set of property ids 0xA001+3n / 0xA002+3n via G7/a, G7/b = existing items msg:op:c22705 / c32705; not a new message); (j) getOpCode()==N / case N in DefaultNoOperationMessageState (N = 4870..4880 there are model ids, not opcodes); (k) p056e8/h.java JHSchedulerSubCommand values vs every U8.e implementer (only V8/c, always Schedule) -> no Set sub-command 2.

items.title: Vendor opcode wire encoding
items.details: Send: {(byte)(opCode|0xC0), CID lo, CID hi} - only the low 6 bits of the Java int survive (JUNG ints are 0x0527xx). Receive: first byte >= 0xC0 -> 3-byte opcode, opCode = b0&0x3F, CID = b2<<8|b1; JUNG re-encodes status opcodes as b0<<16|b1<<8|b2 (e.g. 0xC52705) in P7.a.e.

items.title: Incoming access/proxy message dispatch
items.details: Opcode length from first byte (<0x80 ->1, <=0xBF ->2, else 3). 1-byte branch: 0x02,0x04,0x05,0x5E,0x06,0x40,0x51,0x57,0x58,0x5B,0x52,0x53,0x54,0x5F,0x4A/0x46/0x4E,0x5D; 2-byte branch: config statuses, 0x8212, generic/light/scene/scheduler/time statuses; 3-byte: any CID != 0 -> VendorModelMessageStatus (modelId from pending request or 0). Anything else -> onUnknownPduReceived.

items.title: JUNG LSB-first bit packer for vendor payloads
items.details: k0.n(value, nBits) appends from bit 0 of byte 0, field LSB first, spilling into next byte; m() flushes with zero padding. M.f(nBits) reads the same way. Used for JH Scheduler, Scene Action Setup and AstroScheduler property payloads (Nordic BitWriter/BitReader are MSB-first and used with byte reversal for SIG Time/Scheduler).

items.title: JUNG request/response matching
items.details: Every Acknowledged request carries the expected status opcode (MessageBuilder.d()); completion on first message from src with that opcode (or D1 27 05 unless the request is an LBC Admin Get/Set of property 9). If request opcode == expected opcode the app does not wait. Model App Bind waits 3000 ms for 0x803E. Raw read/writeProperty use unacknowledged c.b (no wait). Quirk: GetSubscriptionMessageBuilder (p234v7/A) expects 0x8029 (the Get opcode itself) instead of 0x802A, so it never waits.

items.title: Config AppKey Add
items.details: Opcode 0x00 (1-byte, int 0); model Configuration Server 0x0000 (app acts as Configuration Client); app sends; acked (-> 0x8003 AppKey Status); DevKey (ConfigMessage: AKF=0, AID=0). Params: 19 B: [0] NetKeyIndex bits0-7, [1] NetKeyIndex bits8-11 | AppKeyIndex bits0-3<<4, [2] AppKeyIndex bits4-11, [3..18] AppKey 16 B (12-bit indexes packed LE via addKeyIndexPadding). Ctor rejects keys != 16 B. JUNG layer builds it. JUNG: AddAppKeyMessageBuilder (p234v7/C2353d) sends it with the network's app key after provisioning, expects 0x8003.

items.title: Config AppKey Update
items.details: Opcode 0x01 (1-byte, int 1); model Configuration Server 0x0000 (app acts as Configuration Client); app sends; acked (-> 0x8003); DevKey (ConfigMessage: AKF=0, AID=0). Params: 19 B: packed NetKeyIndex (=appKey.getBoundNetKeyIndex()) + AppKeyIndex (3 B) + new AppKey 16 B. Library only: no JUNG-layer caller/resolver/expected-status (grep of de/ A7-H7 P7 p234v7 p245w7 p254x7 p277z7).

items.title: Config Composition Data Status
items.details: Opcode 0x02 (1-byte, int 2); model Configuration Server 0x0000 (app acts as Configuration Client); app parses; status; DevKey (ConfigMessage: AKF=0, AID=0). Params: Page u8, CID u16, PID u16, VID u16, CRPL u16, Features u16, then elements (Loc u16, NumS u8, NumV u8, SIG model ids u16[], vendor ids CID+ID u16 LE -> stored as (CID<<16)|ID). Dispatched as 1-byte opcode; stored on node unless received via proxy filter; updates mesh network. JUNG waits for it as expected status (p234v7/C2373n.java).

items.title: Config Model Publication Set
items.details: Opcode 0x03 (1-byte, int 3); model Configuration Server 0x0000 (app acts as Configuration Client); app sends; acked (-> 0x8019); DevKey (ConfigMessage: AKF=0, AID=0). Params: 11 B (SIG) / 13 B (vendor): ElementAddr u16, PublishAddr u16, AppKeyIndex 12 bit | CredentialFlag<<4 (byte 5 high nibble), PublishTTL u8, PublishPeriod u8 (resolution<<6 | steps&0x3F), PublishRetransmit u8 (intervalSteps<<3 | count&7), ModelId u16 or vendor (CID LE, ModelID LE). JUNG layer builds it. JUNG: PublicationMessageBuilder (p234v7/C2383s0) sends credentialFlag=false, publishTtl=255 (use default TTL), period steps/resolution from the capability (0 if unset), retransmit count 0 / interval 0; the AppKeyIndex argument is applicationKey.getBoundNetKeyIndex() (NetKey index, equal to the AppKey index 0 only by coincidence).

items.title: Generic Location Global Status
items.details: Opcode 0x40 (1-byte, int 64); model Generic Location Server 0x100E; app parses; status; AppKey (ApplicationMessage: AKF=1, AID=K4(appKey)). Params: 10 B: GlobalLatitude s32 LE, GlobalLongitude s32 LE, GlobalAltitude s16 LE (other lengths -> notConfigured). Lat = v/(2^31-1)*90, Lon = v/(2^31-1)*180; 0x80000000 = not configured; alt 0x7FFF not configured, 0x7FFE >= 32766. JUNG layer builds it. items.title: JH Scheduler Status: Schedule
items.details: Same bit layout as the full Schedule Set (index 4, sub 4, type 4, pad 4, dayOfWeek 7, pad 1, notBeforeMM 6, notBeforeHH 5, notAfterMM 6, notAfterHH 5, pad 2, offsetMin 8 two's complement); 1-byte status = nothing stored.

items.title: JH Scheduler Status: Action
items.details: index 4, sub 4, actionCode 8 (0 NoAction,1 Switching,2 Lightness,3 Lightness+CT,4 Blinds+Slats,5 TargetTemperature), 40-bit payload: 1 on u8; 2 lightness u16 (pct*65535/100); 3 lightness u16 + CT u16 Kelvin (2000..10000); 4 blind s16 + slat s16 (Generic Level range); 5 temperature*100 u16. 1-byte status = unchanged.

items.title: JH Scheduler Status: EffectiveTime
items.details: 56 bits: index 4, sub 4, type 4, ignored 4, dayOfWeek 7, ignored 1, effectiveTimeMM 6, effectiveTimeHH 5, ignored 13, offsetMin 8 (computed next trigger for astro schedules).

items.title: JH Scheduler Status: ScheduleList
items.details: 6 B: header byte (0xF0), centralScheduleId echo (skipped, 16 bits total), then 16 x 2-bit JHSchedulerStatus (0 Available, 1 CentralScheduleIdMatched, 2 Inactive, 3 Active) for slots 0..15 LSB-first.

items.title: JH Scheduler Set: Schedule
items.details: Full form 8 B: index 4, sub 0 (4), type 4 (JHSchedulerType 0 Available,1 Reserved,2 TimedInactive,3 TimedActive,4 SunriseInactive,5 SunriseActive,6 SunsetInactive,7 SunsetActive), 0 (4), dayOfWeek 7 (Mon=0x01..Sun=0x40), 0 (1), notBeforeMM 6, notBeforeHH 5, notAfterMM 6, notAfterHH 5, 0 (2), offsetMin 8 (After n -> n, Before n -> 256-n), 0 (8). Toggle/type-only form 2 B: index 4, sub 0, type 4, 0 (4) when no day/time fields are set.

items.title: JH Scheduler Set: Action
items.details: 7 B: index 4, sub 1 (4), actionCode 8, 40-bit payload exactly as msg:sub:d32705-1 (unused bits zero).
